name: SQL project database definition import/export API
description: The REST APIs for SQL database in Fabric are being extended to support the full SQL project file format in addition to the existing dacpac format. These APIs enable you to retrieve the code definition of your databases or have your database dynamically updated based on a code definition that you provide.- https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/fabric/sqldatabase/items/get-sql-database-definition?tabs=HTTP- https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/fabric/sqldatabase/items/update-sql-databases-definition?tabs=HTTPLearn more about SQL projects from https://aka.ms/sqlprojects
